# Muhammad Talha — Full-Stack Developer (Next.js, Node.js) & AI SaaS Builder

## Profile Summary
Muhammad Talha is a full-stack software engineer specializing in Next.js, Node.js, and applied AI integrations. He builds production-ready SaaS platforms, e-commerce applications, and multi-tenant inventory management systems. 

## Core Technical Stack
- Frontend: React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, REST APIs
- Database & Auth: MongoDB, NextAuth, Appwrite, JWT, Bcrypt
- Applied AI & Infrastructure: Mistral API, LLM structured output parsing, Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Microsoft Azure

## Experience & Key Projects
- HandoutAI (AI-Powered EdTech SaaS): Built a production application converting uploaded study materials (PDF/DOCX/TXT) into interactive MCQ quizzes. Engineered the LLM integration using the Mistral API, implementing automated structural retries, token length estimation, and a credit-deduction billing system.
- Freelance Full-Stack Developer: Developed frontend features and backend logic for US e-commerce and Australian marketplace platforms using React.js, Next.js, and NestJS.
- completeMe (E-Commerce Platform): Developed a Next.js and TypeScript storefront featuring complete cart management, order tracking, and Stripe API integration for secure payment processing.
- Inventory & POS System: Built a multi-tenant Node.js/React platform featuring real-time stock tracking, role-based access control (RBAC), and transactional Point-of-Sale checkout logic.
- BlogWise: Full-stack content management system featuring robust user authentication and rich-text post generation using React, Appwrite, and Redux Toolkit.
